title: Paisano Baptist Encampment

services.name: Reservations and Rentals
services.desc: Cost for RV sites are $110.00 per site. Full payment must be made at the time of reservation confirmation. Previous renters have the first choice to rent the same RV site as the prior year. The encampment no longer has cabins available to rent. blurb: Located in the beautiful Davis Mountains of West Texas, Paisano Baptist Encampment is a 10 to 15 minute drive from both Marfa and Alpine. Family Camp (general encampment) meets each summer, the last full week of July.
